text:
Maya: quick follow-ups from today's runtime roadmap section — had a couple live Qs about batching, caching, and kernel timelines. jotting them here for leadership/eng to chime in :wave:

Asha: first — are we still targeting prefix/KV cache autosave by end of Q2? i thought that was pushed? :thinking_face:

Keegan: short answer: timeline slid. delivery is now early Q3. engineering uncovered serialization edge cases with partial KV eviction. working with infra to harden tests.

Maya: can you explain the impact on latency SLOs for hosted API while that's in flight?

Keegan: not expecting SLO regressions. current behavior is conservative: cache miss => fallback to existing fast-path, so p50/p95 unchanged. p99 might see a few extra RPCs during heavy churn until cache warms. we'll monitor via per-route traces.

Ben: on the kernel side — any change to priority of fused attention work vs int8 quant kernels? we need both but limited kernel engineering cycles.

Keegan: good call. priority order is: 1) fused-attn for long-context models (big latency wins), 2) int8 kernels (cost win for many models), 3) misc ops. we split team so progress happens in parallel but with smaller scope deliveries.

Asha: what does "smaller scope deliveries" mean — will there be incremental rollouts we can opt into on Dedicated?

Jordan: yes. plan is phased rollouts. we'll expose kernel variants as model "profiles" customers can opt into on Dedicated/Dedicated-private before defaulting to them on Hosted. canary traffic -> metrics -> promote.

Maya: excellent. can we get a doc/one-pager on the opt-in process and fallback behavior? Product wants to update the Dedicated onboarding page.

Ben: also, for quantization testing — what's the regression gate? unit-level accuracy + 1k prompts smoke tests?

Keegan: current plan: unit ops tests, model-level evals on our standard eval harness (1k prompt suite), and nightly long-run to catch stability. we require no >2% regression on our quality metric before promote.

Asha: who owns the eval harness changes? i can help QA-ing the new prompt sets.

Keegan: Keegan + ML infra own harness changes; Asha — please sync with Keegan, we'll add you to the eval PRs.

Maya: is there any risk of capacity pressure when enabling KV caching + fused-attn together? like memory bump on certain GPU types?

Keegan: yes, there are combos where fused-attn increases temp memory, and KV caching obviously increases memory footprint. we plan to add a compatibility matrix per GPU SKU and automated fallbacks to smaller batch sizes or alternative kernels on low-memory instances.

Jordan: ops note: we'll also add a safety policy to routing that prevents routing heavy long-context traffic to low-memory machines until the matrix is updated.

deploy-bot: deploy notice — canary job "kernel-fused-attn-canary" started at 1779457001, target=5% traffic on staging, monitors=latency,p99-errors.

Maya: perfect — please post results in #eng-runtime once canary completes. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
